name: Seomgwangcheonsa Litona Liliche
source:
Gi-shin Cheon, a genius scientist, lives with an AI girl in the lab of the remote forest. He has a Hero suit, but he doesn't want to use it. He hates being a hero.

One day a magical girl, Liliche, appears before him. She urges him to escape from the city as soon as possible to save his life.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/923900/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
天才科学家千奇信和人工智能女孩住在偏远森林的实验室里。他有一套英雄套装，但他不想使用它。他讨厌当英雄。

有一天，一位魔法少女莉莉切出现在他的面前。她敦促他尽快逃离这座城市以挽救他的生命。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/923900/]Steam[/url]]
